label: reported
text: According to Telegraph India, an anonymous resident in Düsseldorf reported receiving messages about a new youth initiative called "Gen Z steht auf." The publication stated that the initiative called for protests in 21 German cities on October 31 regarding issues such as education funding, living costs, social services, and compulsory military service.
